defects.description: The frozen runner's build_run_manifest() function (scripts/run_r13_confirmation.py line 475) incorrectly sets confirmation_executable_sha256 to the value of runtime_config_sha256 instead of computing the actual confirmation executable hash. The actual confirmation executable SHA (41cc60b04f506f63b80c91e036d330d61d79992a86fb975cbe21597bd2d84f57) is only written to confirmation_executable_sha256.txt at the end of the run.
defects.resolution: validate executable identity independently from experiment_source_commit, protocol_sha256, gguf_sha256, runtime_config_sha256, backend_identity, receipt_identity_sha256, and confirmation_executable_sha256.txt (when available at end of run). Do NOT require run_manifest.confirmation_executable_sha256 to equal 41cc60b04f506f63... — that field is known to be defective.

defects.description: During Segment 3, the llama-server was restarted with optimized performance parameters (-t 8, --batch-size 4096, --ubatch-size 1024) instead of the frozen R13 runtime configuration (-t 4, --batch-size 2048, --ubatch-size 512). Scientific parameters (parallel=4, ctx=32768, temp=0.0, seed=42, model, max_tokens) were unchanged, but thread count and batch sizes differ from the frozen runtime identity. This could affect latency/cost measurements and potentially generated actions depending on llama.cpp execution/numerics.
defects.scientific_execution_affected: potentially — latency/cost measurements affected; generated actions may differ depending on llama.cpp numerics with different thread/batch config
defects.resolution: 28 deviant trajectories quarantined. results.jsonl rewritten to contain only 615 frozen-runtime trajectories. Server reverted to exact frozen config (-t 4, --batch-size 2048, --ubatch-size 512). R13 resumed from 615/1280. The 28 quarantined keys will be rerun under the frozen runtime and the new results will be part of the clean confirmation set.
